steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The National Minimum Wage sets legal pay floors based on age: lower rates for under-18s and 18-20 year olds, a higher rate for 21-22 year olds, and the National Living Wage for workers aged 23+.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Workers have the right to a written statement of employment terms from day one, including pay, hours, holiday entitlement, and notice periods.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The maximum working week is 48 hours (averaged over 17 weeks) unless the worker voluntarily opts out. Young workers (under 18) are limited to 40 hours per week and 8 hours per day.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Workers are entitled to at least 5.6 weeks (28 days for full-time) of paid holiday per year, which can include bank holidays.
